statutory_frameworks.official_title: Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2022 (PSTI)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Office for Product Safety and Standards (OPSS)

metadata.mandates: Universal default passwords banned, mandatory vulnerability disclosure policy, minimum security update periods declared

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Data Protection Act 2018 and UK General Data Protection Regulation
Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018 as amended (UK NIS)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) / Sector Regulators (Ofgem, Ofwat, CAA)

metadata.scope: Operators of Essential Services (OES) and Relevant Digital Service Providers (RDSPs)

cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Declaration of Conformity (DoC) under PSTI; UKCA marking
cyber_security_mandates.details: PSTI Schedule 1 strictly outlaws factory default passwords (must be unique per device or generated upon initialization) and mandates published support period for security updates.

data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: No general localization. Adequate with EU under reciprocal European Commission Adequacy Decision.
data_privacy_sovereignty.cross_border_transfer_mechanism: UK Adequacy Regulations, International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA), UK Addendum to EU SCCs

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: Export Control Order 2008 Category 5 Part 2. Open General Export Licence (Cryptographic Development).
cryptography_controls.approved_encryption_standards: AES-256, NCSC Commercial Product Assurance (CPA) cryptographic primitives, FIPS 140-3
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: NCSC Guidance: Migration to post-quantum cryptography in critical systems starting 2025; stateful hash-based signatures for firmware signing.

incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Risk to rights and freedoms of individuals.

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: NIS Operator of Essential Services Incident
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Significant impact on the continuity of the essential service.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
